CustomField.description: Sets how the Universal Budget claim sheet measures each line on this budget. Unchecked (the default): Budgeted, Prior Claimed and Remaining show only the claim's period. Checked: each of those figures shows the claim's period on top and the total for every period of the budget beneath it, so a grantee sees what is left on the line for the whole grant and can claim against money planned for a later period; each Remaining line turns red on its own. Either way the claim is recorded in the claim's period; when the line has no amount in that period, saving the claim adds one at zero first. Allocation mode only; ignored in Direct mode. Replace it with a formula to set the scope per program, stage or template. Takes effect only when mapped as the Budget Claim Across Periods Field on the Budget Configuration.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked: Budgeted, Prior Claimed and Remaining show the claim's period with the total for every period beneath it, so a claim can draw on money planned in any period. Unchecked: they show the claim's period only. Claims are always recorded in the claim's period. Allocation mode only.
CustomField.label: Claim Across Periods
